table.pos: Column heading of a lap-time list: the place. Short for position; keep it very short.
table.sector: Column heading: sector time. {n}: 1, 2 or 3. S = sector; keep it very short.
table.actions: Screen-reader name of the column of buttons at the end of each row.
table.fastestHere: Tooltip on the fastest time in a column.
table.fastest: Screen-reader text after the fastest time in a column.
table.myPlace: The player's place on a lap board. {rank}: their place; {total}: drivers on the board, both already formatted. P1 = first place.
input.drivenWith: Tooltip on the small icon showing what a lap was driven with.
conditions.full: Badge on a lap: driven with Full realism. Very short.
conditions.standard: Badge on a lap: driven with Standard realism. Very short.
conditions.casual: Badge on a lap: driven with Casual realism. Very short.
conditions.pro: Badge on a lap: driven with no assists (the Pro assist level). Very short.
conditions.semiPro: Badge on a lap: driven with some assists (the Semi-Pro assist level). Very short.
conditions.assisted: Badge on a lap: driven with full assists. Very short.
conditions.wet: Badge on a lap driven on a wet track. Very short.
conditions.wetTitle: Tooltip on the Wet badge: the racing line was wet.
online.drivers: Drivers on a board. {count} picks the plural form; {drivers}: the same number, already formatted (1,204).
online.totals: Totals under a board's heading. {laps} and {drivers}: numbers already formatted; {lapCount} and {driverCount} pick the plural forms.
online.behind: Gap to the driver one place ahead. {gap}: seconds such as 0.214 (s = seconds, keep the unit); {driver}: their name.
online.raceGhost: Tooltip on a button that races a recorded lap's ghost car.
online.raceGhostOf: Screen-reader name of that button. {driver}: the driver whose lap it is.
online.raceGhostAhead: Button: race the ghost of the driver one place ahead of you.
online.applySetup: Tooltip on a button that loads the car setup saved with a lap.
online.applySetupFrom: Screen-reader name of that button. {driver}: the driver whose lap it is.
online.board: Screen-reader name of the switch between your car's board and every car's.
online.myCar: Board of the car you are driving. Short.
online.myCarNamed: Screen-reader name of My car. {car}: car name, not translated.
online.physicsVersion: Picks which version of the physics the board's laps were driven on.
online.filters: Button that opens the board's filters.
online.filtersOn: The same button while filters are on. {count}: how many.
online.noAssists: Filter: only laps driven without assists.
online.fullRealism: Filter: only laps driven with Full realism.
online.wetLaps: Filter: only laps driven on a wet track.
online.emptyOlderFiltered: {version}: an older board's name such as Physics V1.
online.emptyOlder: {version}: an older board's name such as Physics V1.
online.tableLabel: Screen-reader name of the board's table. {board}: car, circuit and board names joined by ·.
online.pages: Screen-reader name of the page buttons under the board.
online.pageOf: Page counter. Keep the tags around the page number; they style it.
online.yourRowHere: Why Jump to me is unavailable: the player's row is already on this page.
online.jumpToMe: Button: go to the page with the player's own row.
hallOfFame.medal: Screen-reader name of a weekly challenge medal: gold for 1st, silver for 2nd, bronze for 3rd.
hallOfFame.medalShort: Place on a weekly challenge podium, written on the medal badge. Very short.
hallOfFame.physics: A physics version. {version}: V1, V2, not translated.
hallOfFame.inProgress: Badge: this week's challenge is still running.
hallOfFame.podium: Screen-reader name of a week's podium. {event}: the week's id (2026-W47); {version}: V1, V2.
hallOfFame.recordHolders: Drivers who hold the fastest lap on boards with enough drivers.
hallOfFame.recordHoldersHint: {min}: the number of drivers a board needs to count. P1 = first place.
hallOfFame.mostDecorated: Drivers with the most weekly challenge medals.
hallOfFame.goldCount: Screen-reader text: how many gold medals a driver has.
hallOfFame.silverCount: Screen-reader text: how many silver medals a driver has.
hallOfFame.bronzeCount: Screen-reader text: how many bronze medals a driver has.
driverBadges.short.gold: One-letter tag of the weekly challenge gold medal badge beside a driver's name. G = Gold.
driverBadges.short.silver: One-letter tag of the silver medal badge. S = Silver.
driverBadges.short.bronze: One-letter tag of the bronze medal badge. B = Bronze.
driverBadges.short.og: Tag of the badge for players who drove the first physics version (original). Keep it short.
driverBadges.flCompact: Tag of the Fastest Lap badge in a list row. FL = Fastest Lap. ×# shows how many, only past one.
driverBadges.flClassCompact: The Fastest Lap tag with the car class's short code, such as FL·GT3. {class} is not translated.
driverBadges.fastestLap: Badge for holding the fastest lap on a board. ×# shows how many, only past one.
driverBadges.classFastestLap: {class}: a car class (short code or name).
driverBadges.classFl: {class}: a car class's short code. FL = Fastest Lap.
driverBadges.moreRecords: Screen-reader name of the +N badge: more fastest-lap records than the row shows.
driverBadges.shortTimes: A badge's short tag with how many the driver holds, shown only past one. {short}: the tag, already translated.
driverBadges.named: A badge's full name with how many the driver holds, shown only past one. {name}: the badge's name, already translated.
driverBadges.tooltip: Tooltip on a badge: {label}, its name; {detail}, what it was given for.
driverBadges.inspect: Screen-reader name of a Fastest Lap badge you can open. {badge}: the badge's name.
driverBadges.popoverTitleNamed: Heading of the list of a driver's fastest-lap records. {driver}: their name.
driverBadges.contested: {min}: the number of drivers a board needs to count. P1 = first place.
driverBadges.scopeCount: Switch button: records in this car or class. {scope}: car or class name; {count}: how many.
driverBadges.allClasses: Switch button: records in every car class. {count}: how many.
driverBadges.boardDrivers: Tooltip: how many drivers have a lap on this board. {drivers}: the number; {count} picks the plural form.
driverBadges.driversShort: How many drivers are on a board, very short. drv = drivers.
driverBadges.manual: Records given by hand by the developer. {count}: how many.
driverBadges.manualNote: {count}: how many; {note}: the developer's note, not translated.
driverBadges.legend.key: Screen-reader name of the key that explains the badge tags.
driverBadges.legend.weekly: Key entry for the weekly challenge medals shown: the places they stand for (1st, 2nd, 3rd).
driverBadges.legend.trackRecord: Key entry: the FL badge means a fastest-lap record.
driverBadges.legend.og: Key entry: the OG badge means the driver drove the first physics version (V1).
driverBadges.legend.bulb: Key entry: the light-bulb badge means the driver's idea made it into the game.
online.circuit: Screen-reader name of the circuit picker above a lap board.
online.car: Screen-reader name of the car picker of a lap board.
profile.loadingStats: Screen-reader text while a driver's profile loads.
profile.bestLaps: Card title: the driver's best lap on each circuit.
profile.loadingBestLaps: Screen-reader text while the list loads.
profile.driverStats: Card title when the profile could not load.
profile.ratingTitle: Tooltip on the driver's rating (0 to 100).
profile.outOf100: Screen-reader text after the rating number, e.g. '72.4 out of 100'.
profile.rating: Label under the driver's rating number (0 to 100).
profile.circuits: Label under the number of circuits the driver has a lap on. The number is shown above it, not in this text.
profile.boards: Label under the number of lap boards (circuit and car pairs) the driver is on. The number is shown above it.
profile.openRaces: Card title: the driver's record in online races anyone can join.
profile.races: Label under the number of open races started. The number is shown above it.
profile.wins: Label under the number of wins. The number is shown above it.
profile.podiums: Label under the number of podium finishes. The number is shown above it.
profile.bestFinish: Label under the driver's best race result, e.g. P2.
profile.bestLapsNote: Line under the Best laps title.
profile.sortLabel: Screen-reader name of the sort switch.
profile.sortRank: Sort option: best board position first. Short.
profile.sortCircuit: Sort option: by circuit name. Short.
profile.sortRecent: Sort option: newest laps first. Short.
profile.tableLabel: Screen-reader name of the table. {name}: the driver's name.
profile.ofBoard: After a board position, e.g. 'P3 of 120'. {total}: drivers on that board, already formatted.
profile.openBoard: Tooltip on a circuit name: opens that circuit's lap board for that car.
profile.ariaNamed: Screen-reader name of the profile window. {name}: the driver's name.
profile.aria: Screen-reader name of the profile window before the name is known.
profile.refreshLabel: Screen-reader name of the refresh button.
table.viewProfile: Tooltip on a driver's name on a lap board. {name}: the driver's name.
driverBadges.legend.creator: Legend line for the Creator badge: the person who made LibreCorsa.
